title: Metadata client with TTL cache & request coalescing

user_story.i_want: catalog lookups served from an in-memory cache with a TTL
user_story.so_that: classifying millions of records doesn't hit DynamoDB once per record

description: Define a `MetadataStore` trait with `source(id)` and `entry(source_id, name)`, both async and both returning `Result<Option<_>>`. Implement `DynamoMetadataStore`. Wrap any store in `CachedMetadataStore<S>` using moka's async cache: TTL 5 min, max 10k entries. Cache negative results (None) with a shorter TTL (30 s). Use moka's get_with/try_get_with so 100 concurrent misses on the same key make one DynamoDB call.

acceptance_criteria.then: the inner store is called exactly once (counting fake)

acceptance_criteria.when: it is looked up twice within 30 s and again after 30 s
acceptance_criteria.then: the inner store is called twice in total

acceptance_criteria.given: the inner store returns an error
acceptance_criteria.then: the error is not cached and is surfaced as retryable

rust_concepts: Generic structs with trait bounds (CachedMetadataStore<S: MetadataStore>)
